items.description: Renew boiler system including flue gas system and storage tank
items.rationale: Policy 2.4.5 and 7.1.1(c): Boiler, flue, and storage tank are plant of the building and were rendered unusable by the insured escape-of-water event. However, reference case 30 shows that the lowest charge for this work was proven too high and t < 2000, possibly 0. No evidence of a lower, fairer charge in this case, so t is capped at the proven threshold.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to fit the replacement boiler
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(d): Adaptation of supply pipework is part of putting the new boiler into service and is indemnified if the boiler itself is. Reference case 30: lowest charge for this work was proven too high, t < 300, possibly 0.

items.description: Dispose of the old boiler system
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a): Disposal of the destroyed plant is indemnified if the plant itself is. Reference case 30: lowest charge for this work was proven too high, t < 150, possibly 0.

Policy 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(d): Only the first journey charge per insured event is indemnified. Reference cases and price priors: t per pc about 83 (80% range 80–87). This is the first vehicle cost on the invoice.

items.description: Electrician labour checking and rewiring the flooded basement circuits
items.rationale: Policy 2.4.5 and 7.1.5: Electrical installation is plant of the building and covered if exposed to escaped water. However, reference case 30: t = 0 for this line (not indemnified: nobody was paid anything), so this is not indemnified.

items.description: Small electrical materials for the rewiring
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(c): Materials built into covered work are indemnified, but reference case 30: t = 0 for this line (not indemnified: nobody was paid anything), so this is not indemnified.

items.description: Water extraction from the flooded plant room
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.2: Water extraction is a loss-mitigation measure, but reference case 30: t = 0 for this line (not indemnified: nobody was paid anything), so this is not indemnified.
